acceptanceCriteria: A review-stage claim gets a packet built from native records: delta base = newest ancestor commit with a passed review, diff limited to test and fixture paths, the last returned review's items each marked touched/untouched by the delta, obligations the delta touches (changed test identities, cited lines), and a saved partial checkpoint for the same commit.

The packet has a byte cap; content beyond it is listed as exact source ranges to read on demand, never dropped silently; a several-round ticket fixture stays under the cap and names every returned item.
With no passed ancestor the packet falls back to the full diff and says so; the packet is placed in the dispatched session prompt and the full record is not read by default.
Requirements in the owning domain spec (dispatch/external-reviews/obligation ledger, not the full leases spec); focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1169.
body: GitHub #1169. Review-stage sessions get the whole ticket history; after a few rounds reviewers hit the context limit before a verdict, hand off, and restart (largest source of no-progress review sessions). An adopter packet builder cut packets to ~10-12 KB. Requested: dispatch/tasks build a bounded review packet: delta base (newest passed-review ancestor) and diff limited to test/fixture paths; last returned items with touched/untouched status; touched obligations only; any partial checkpoint for the same commit; a size cap that names omitted source ranges.
title: GH #1169: dispatch: bounded review packet for review-stage claims (delta since last passed review, returned items, touched obligations, capped with named ranges)
